    Plot ACE catch trends by year

    plot_ace.Rd

    Takes the output of sum_ace() and plots total catch (t) as a line against year, optionally coloured and/or faceted by another grouping column still present in the data (e.g. OCEAN_CODE, FLAG_CODE, GEAR_CODE, SP_CODE). Data are re-aggregated internally over YY, colour_by and facet_by so lines are always clean, regardless of which other grouping columns remain in data.

    plot_ace(data, colour_by = NULL, facet_by = NULL, facet_scales = "fixed")

    Arguments

    data

    A tibble as returned by sum_ace(), containing at least YY and sum_catch_mt.

    colour_by

    Optional. Bare column name to colour lines by (e.g. SP_CODE). Defaults to NULL (single line, no colour grouping).

    facet_by

    Optional. Bare column name to facet by (e.g. OCEAN_CODE). Defaults to NULL (no facetting).

    facet_scales

    Passed to ggplot2::facet_wrap()'s scales argument when facet_by is supplied. Defaults to "fixed".

    Value

    A ggplot2::ggplot() object.

    Examples

    if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
ace_output <- sum_ace(ocean = "WX", species = c("YFT", "SKJ"))

# Single line, total catch by year
plot_ace(ace_output)

# Coloured by species
plot_ace(ace_output, colour_by = SP_CODE)

# Coloured by species, faceted by ocean, free y-scales per panel
plot_ace(ace_output, colour_by = SP_CODE, facet_by = OCEAN_CODE, facet_scales = "free_y")
} # }
